from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-medium-seq0/frozen/held-out/play/users/u033/system/state/workspace/programs/task-5c83d0f3.py')
code='''from collections import deque

def _components(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    seen = set()
    result = []
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if color == 0 or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            q = deque([(r, c)])
            seen.add((r, c))
            cells = []
            while q:
                y, x = q.popleft()
                cells.append((y, x))
                for yy, xx in ((y-1,x),(y+1,x),(y,x-1),(y,x+1)):
                    if 0 <= yy < h and 0 <= xx < w and (yy,xx) not in seen and grid[yy][xx] == color:
                        seen.add((yy,xx))
                        q.append((yy,xx))
            minr = min(y for y, x in cells)
            minc = min(x for y, x in cells)
            shape = frozenset((y-minr, x-minc) for y, x in cells)
            result.append((color, cells, shape))
    return result

def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    comps = _components(grid)
    references = [comp for comp in comps if comp[0] != 1]
    for color, cells, shape in comps:
        if color != 1:
            continue
        cy = sum(y for y, x in cells) / len(cells)
        cx = sum(x for y, x in cells) / len(cells)
        matches = [ref for ref in references if ref[2] == shape]
        if matches:
            ref = min(matches, key=lambda comp: abs(cy-sum(y for y,x in comp[1])/len(comp[1])) + abs(cx-sum(x for y,x in comp[1])/len(comp[1])))
            for y, x in cells:
                out[y][x] = ref[0]
    return out
'''
p.write_text(code)
# Run tests against all three demos and test grid
